# Pfizer sales outside COVID grew while group revenue stayed flat
# Pfizer Q3 2026 Earnings Review

Pfizer reported its quarter ended September 27 on November 3. Revenue was **$16.583 billion**, down 0.4% year over year and broadly flat excluding currency effects. Adjusted diluted EPS was **$0.87**, the same rounded figure as last year and down 2% excluding currency effects. Revenue and adjusted EPS exceeded the **$15.87 billion and $0.73** expectations in the LSEG snapshot reported by Reuters.
# Pfizer earnings benefited from a smaller licensing expense
GAAP net income fell from **$3.541 billion to $3.242 billion** and diluted EPS from $0.62 to $0.56. Pre-tax profit actually rose $51 million. Tax moved from a $216 million benefit to a $134 million expense, largely because the year-ago quarter included favorable deferred-tax remeasurement and agreements with tax authorities. Adjusted income was $4.985 billion, up 1%, and diluted weighted-average shares rose 0.6%.
# Pfizer cash flow improved and the annual guide rose
Pfizer lifted its annual revenue range to **$62–$64 billion** from $60.5–$62.5 billion and narrowed adjusted diluted EPS guidance to **$2.95–$3.05** from $2.80–$3.00. At the midpoint, that is $1.5 billion more revenue and $0.10 more adjusted EPS. The new range absorbs roughly $0.10 per share from the Innovent upfront.
